versions.changelog:
- Initial beta release of the skill.
- Added unified dispatcher for Alibaba Cloud Lakehouse Migration Center, routing user requests to SQL conversion, data validation, or big-data workflow migration sub-skills.
- Defined trigger keywords and routing actions for each sub-skill.
- Provided detailed path resolution and invocation instructions for monorepo and independent package deployments.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

Initial unified dispatcher for Alibaba Cloud Lakehouse Migration Center.  
- Adds single entry point skill coordinating SQL conversion, data validation, and big-data workflow migration sub-skills.
- Intelligent intent recognition routes user requests to the correct sub-skill for SQL conversion, validation, or workflow tasks.
- Supports both absolute file path and skill-name invocation methods; robust fallback if a sub-skill is unavailable.
- Detailed path resolution and sub-agent delegation rules for correct operation in different environments.
- Clear documentation of supported sub-skills, routing triggers, and best practices for agent and sub-agent dispatch.
